answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The signal holds work receipts rather than names, so the timber of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the grove of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
